        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
            for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                out[r][c] = 3

    path = set()
    def addrow(r, c0, c1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            path.add((r, c))

    # From the first 0 square to the upper-middle 9 square.
    addrow(8, 9, 10)
    addrow(7, 9, 11)
    addrow(6, 10, 12)
    addrow(5, 11, 12)

    addrow(2, 15, 22)
    addrow(3, 15, 22)
    addrow(4, 21, 22)

        (9, 18), (9, 19),
        (10, 17), (10, 18),
        (11, 16), (11, 17),
        (12, 15),
    })

    # From the central square down to the lower-center square.
    for r in range(15, 26):
        path.update({(r, 13), (r, 14)})

    # From lower-center to the second 0 square.

        (26, 16), (26, 17), (27, 16),
        (25, 17), (25, 18),
        (24, 17), (24, 18),
        (23, 18), (23, 19),
        (22, 19), (22, 20),
        (21, 20), (21, 21),

    for r, c in path:
        if 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]) and out[r][c] == 1:
